data.gender_notes: Ameet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ameet in Sanskrit is derived from the word ‘Amrut’ meaning immortal or nectar. In Hindu mythology, Amrita, the elixir of immortality, was churned from the ocean by the gods and demons. Ameet is a tribute to the timeless and divine essence of this nectar. The name Ameet carries the meaning “Immortal, Timeless” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ameet usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, timeless and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ameet total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
